links.title: Schengen visa or residence permit for visiting Sweden – Swedish Migration Agency
Visiting Sweden for up to 90 days (entry visa)
Application for Schengen visa (119031)
Third country nationals | The Swedish Police Authority

docs.text: Passport valid at least 3 months after the visa expires, issued within the last 10 years, with 2 blank pages
Completed Schengen visa application form
Individual medical travel insurance of at least EUR 30,000 valid in all Schengen countries
Proof of funds for subsistence and return travel
Proof you will leave Sweden and the Schengen area before the visa expires
Valid round-trip ticket with return within 90 days
Hotel booking confirmation or written invitation from the host
Passport-size photo taken within 6 months (if a representative applies for you)

links.title: Visiting Sweden for up to 90 days (entry visa)
Apply for a visitor's residence permit (more than 90 days) – Swedish Migration Agency
Invite family, friends or partners
Application for Schengen visa (119031)
Application for a visitor's residence permit (165011)

docs.text: Passport valid at least 3 months after the end of the visit
Invitation form completed by the host in Sweden
Copy of the host's ID document (residence permit card not accepted)
Host's proof of income and assets if the host pays for the visit
Population Register extract for the host from the Swedish Tax Agency (visits up to 90 days)
Medical travel insurance valid for the entire stay
Proof of financial means for the stay (bank statement, pay slip or employment certificate)
Round-trip ticket (Schengen visa)
Guarantor form and guarantor's ID copy if someone else supports you (more than 90 days)
Copy of a valid residence permit from another Schengen country, if held
Power of attorney if someone else applies for you

links.title: Apply for a residence permit to run your own business in Sweden – Swedish Migration Agency
Look for work or start a business
Visiting Sweden for up to 90 days (entry visa)
Application for Schengen visa (119031)

docs.text: Invitation from the company or conference organiser (business trip on a Schengen visa)
Passport copies
Bank statements for the last 3 months and proof of funds to support yourself for 2 years
Proof of funds to run (and if applicable buy) the business
Certificate of incorporation for the Swedish business
Contracts with customers, suppliers and business premises
Balance sheet and profit and loss statement for the current financial year
Certificate of Swedish or English language skills
Degree certificates and certificates from previous employers
Annual accounts for the 2 most recent years, if the business has been active
Degree certificate and list of subjects (second-cycle degree) for the look-for-work/start-a-business permit
Proof of comprehensive health insurance valid in Sweden (look-for-work/start-a-business permit)

docs.text: Passport copies
Employment contract signed by you and your employer
Proof of comprehensive health insurance (employment of one year or less)
Power of attorney if a representative applies for you
Degree certificate or certificates from previous employers (EU Blue Card)
Rental agreement or certificate of housing (seasonal work)
Proof of professional qualifications if the profession is regulated
Family members: passport copies and marriage certificate or proof of cohabitation
Family members: documents showing the maintenance requirement is met
Children: birth certificate naming the parents and consent from a parent remaining abroad
Documents in Swedish or English; certified translations with original-language copies

links.title: Residence permit for studies in Sweden – Swedish Migration Agency
Apply for a residence permit for studies at higher education – Swedish Migration Agency
Apply for a residence permit for doctoral studies – Swedish Migration Agency
Application for a residence permit for students (113011)

docs.text: Passport copies
Admission decision stating full-time on-site studies in Sweden
Proof of comprehensive health insurance, or of an application for it (studies under one year)
Bank statement issued within 4 months before the permit start date
Scholarship or sponsorship letter, if applicable
Employment certificate and payslips, if claiming employment income
Student grant or loan certificate from your home country, if applicable
Supplementary certificate of enrolment from the institution (doctoral studies)
Power of attorney if a representative applies for you
Documents in Swedish or English; certified translations with original-language copies

links.title: Apply for a residence permit to live with someone in Sweden – Swedish Migration Agency
Residence permit to live with a partner, child or other relative – Swedish Migration Agency
Apply for a residence permit to live with your partner in Sweden – Swedish Migration Agency

docs.text: Certified copies of passport (or EU/EEA national ID card)
Marriage certificate or registered partnership certificate
Proof the marriage is registered in your country of origin, if applicable
Certificate showing you are unmarried, if not married
Proof of shared home and cohabitation (leases or bills with both names)
Pregnancy certificate, if expecting a child together
Children: passport copies, birth certificate, custody documents and consent from the other parent
Power of attorney if your partner in Sweden applies for you
Partner in Sweden: rental contract with latest rent notice, or ownership documents for housing
Partner in Sweden: employment contract and latest payslip, or other proof of income
Documents in Swedish or English; certified translations with original-language copies

docs.text: Passport copies
Certificate of comprehensive health insurance showing insurer, policy number and validity (au pair)
Bank statement dated within 6 months showing the required funds (working holiday)
Copy of return ticket or proof you can afford one (working holiday)
Hosting agreement signed with an approved research principal (researchers)
Admission letter if applying as a doctoral student (researchers)
Medical certificates and proof of payment for treatment (medical treatment visit)
Certificate from the religious organisation (religious purpose visit)
Power of attorney if a representative applies for you
